iLock_Geography
Package iLock_Geography :: Package predicate_library :: Module path
[frames] | no frames]

Module path

The module defines predicate classes that are used to populate geo predicates related to paths.

Classes
  ObjectInPath
Predicate class that builds true point '(path, obj)' if obj of type INSIDE_TYPE_C is in path of type PATH_TYPE.
  NextObjectInPath
Predicate class that builds true point '(path, area_1, area_2)' if area_2 is after area_1 in path of type PATH_TYPE.
  SwitchInPath
Predicate class that builds true point '(path, switch)' if switch of type SWITCH_TYPE is inside of path of type PATH_TYPE.
  EdgeInPath
  LeftInPath
Predicate class that builds true point '(path, switch)' if the left leg of switch of type SWITCH_TYPE is in path of PATH_TYPE.
  RightInPath
Predicate class that builds true point '(path, switch)' if the right leg of switch of type SWITCH_TYPE is in path of PATH_TYPE.
  DivergingPath
Predicate class that builds true point '(path)' if path of type PATH_TYPE contains a facing switch.
  PathIntersectsPath
Predicate class that builds true point '(path_1, path_2)' where path_1 and path_2 of type PATH_TYPE are intersected each other.
  NextPath
Predicate class that builds true point '(path_1, path_2)' if path_1 ends where path_2 starts and they can be joined to a new path.
  PathContainingPath
  RestrictToPaths
  NodeEndObject
  NodeStartObject
